purpose: Initial anti-vignette-only scalar gain fit; no image outputs or repository edits

sampling.fit: SciPy least_squares, soft_l1 loss, f_scale=1 gray level; residual is observed_gray*gain-146

cross_screenshot_checks.images_161131_and_161201_same_crop: Gray-only upper-right sky/corner pixels show about 135 at the extreme corner, 141 in adjacent corner bands, and 146 in the interior where enough gray pixels are present; consistent with primary profile. Cloud coverage limits other corners; colored pixels were not used.
cross_screenshot_checks.duoview_check: Gray-only edge/corner tiles include about 133-134 at outer corners, about 140-141 in adjacent bands, and about 145-146 across interior areas. This supports the same broad falloff, but the views/crops are not treated as geometrically exact correspondences.

limitations: This estimates a display-space correction for the supplied compositor screenshots; it does not establish the 3D location or cause of the vignette.
The flat sky is clipped/plateaued at gray 146 over most of the crop, so onset and shape are weakly constrained; the dark corner pixels carry most of the fit signal.
Image encoding/compositor color domain and any upstream tonemapping are unknown. Treat these values as a starting preset, not a verified in-headset calibration.
